sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Family Courts Amendment Act 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1997
ACT VII OF 1997
FAMILY COURTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Family
Court Act, 7964
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 26th April, 1997]
No.F.9(15)/97‑Legis., dated 26‑4‑1997.‑‑The
following Act of Majlis e‑Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the
President on the 23rd April, 1997, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Family Courts Act, 1964 (W.P. Act XXXV of 1964), for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑--(1) This Act may be called
the Family Courts Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
